page.overview:
Who is One Spider Band?

The One Spider Band is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"P.T. Flea probably can't afford a full band, so he's hired a multi-talented, 8-legged spider. The musical arachnid does his best to keep the show energy high with a fanfare played on a straw and a variety of bottle caps and cans."
